integrity: The sharp block guarantee and its extremizing family are proved analytically. A finite exact-rational checker illustrates the extremizer.
scientific_limitations: Finite, nondegenerate gcd-one positive-integer interarrival support only. The curvature block length is uniform at fixed maximum step, but the onset is not bounded here. Sharpness is for the common guarantee across all four sign sets; arbitrary individual densities are not computed.
title: Sharp block lengths for overshoots and curvature reversals of finite-support renewal masses
